messages:
Sasha: Heads up — kicking off DataCorp POC today. Main asks: Okta SAML SSO, SCIM provisioning (~50k users), group->role mapping, domain ownership verification for tenant isolation. Also need pricing for hosted vs dedicated and the security questionnaire. Who can own tech coord?
Mike: I can own technical coord. @Devon can you confirm SAML bindings and SCIM delta support? Also want to confirm whether DataCorp will use group push vs SCIM groups.
Devon: I can own security. Quick clarifying Qs — do they require assertion encryption? IdP-initiated only or SP-initiated as well? SCIM over mTLS or standard OAuth2 bearer token?
Marie (DataCorp): We use Okta. We need both SP-initiated and IdP-initiated flows. We prefer encrypted assertions (assertion encryption + Encrypted NameID). We plan group push via SCIM; delta updates fine. Scale: ~50k active users, ~2k daily changes.
Mike: Got it. For RBAC we support group->role mapping with simple transform rules. Will validate the SAML attribute name we'll use for roles (e.g., `roles` claim). We also require domain-lock verification for tenant isolation — we can do DNS TXT. Is that acceptable?
Marie (DataCorp): DNS TXT verification is fine. We can provision a short-lived TXT for you.
Sasha: Pricing question from DataCorp: 30-day POC expected, ~200 concurrent users, ~2M tokens/day peak. @Ben (Finance) can you propose hosted trial pricing and a Dedicated eval option?
Ben (Finance): I will prep a compact quote. Hosted POC — usage billing with a temporary 40% trial discount is possible. Dedicated eval — minimal 1-week reserved on a small pool; DM me for numbers, I can do a bundled eval price for POC.
Devon: Security questionnaire notes for the thread: send vendor secques + SOC2 report. We must provide SAML SP metadata endpoint, cert rotation cadence, token/key lifecycle, and SCIM rate limits. FYI our standard SCIM rate limit is 1k reqs/min; we can adjust for POC but will log rate throttles.
Mike: Small sample SAML snippet for DataCorp to check quickly:
```
<EntityDescriptor entityID="https://sp.redwood.ai">
  <SPSSODescriptor>...</SPSSODescriptor>
</EntityDescriptor>
```
Use SP metadata at https://redwood.ai/saml/sp-metadata.xml
Mike: SCIM quick curl example for group push (Okta):
`curl -X POST https://scim.redwood.ai/v2/Groups -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"displayName":"engineering","members":[{"value":"uid:12345"}]}'`
Sasha: Action items — (1) Marie to share Okta metadata + sample user CSV, (2) Sasha to send vendor secques link + SP metadata, (3) Devon to prepare RBAC mapping template, (4) Ben to share a short quote. Target POC start next Tue — ok for everyone?
Marie (DataCorp): I'll upload Okta metadata + sample CSV to the shared S3 link by EOD today. Okta org base: https://datacorp.okta.com. Target start Tue works for us.
deploy-bot: POC ticket created: POC-2347 — channel #poc-datacorp — assignees: Mike, Devon, Sasha.
Mike: I'll provision a canary Private route for the HIPAA-isolated trial week if they want. Marie, DM me the environment contacts and we can lock VLAN + KMS options.
Sasha: Thanks all — I'll follow up with the secques link and set a calendar invite for Tue kickoff. :thumbsup:
